blurb: Guests join tours visiting nearly 50 wineries, breweries, and distilleries in Traverse City, Old Mission Peninsula, and Leelanau Peninsula. Tours include private group options and public join-in tours aboard Mercedes-Benz high-top shuttles. The company also offers limo services for weddings, parties, corporate travel, and airport transportation.
